scenes.name: brass-city
scenes.prompt: At street level inside an immense brass city built across a desert canyon. Tall angular towers rise on both sides of a broad winding avenue that recedes far into the distance. Enormous arched bridges span the canyon overhead. Terraced balconies, gold mechanical stairways, tiny glowing windows and oxidized copper rooftops fill the space. Warm amber sunlight slices through deep red dust and reveals countless architectural layers. A panoramic urban environment, with the avenue and distant skyline occupying the center and tall buildings framing the sides. An intricate surreal visionary painting with sculptural architecture, deep layered space, fine engraved detail, luminous color, dramatic shaded volumes, and a coherent wide cinematic composition.

scenes.name: submerged-garden
scenes.prompt: Inside a vast submerged garden of luminous coral columns and ruined palaces. Looking diagonally upward through turquoise water, huge rose-red coral trees rise along the left foreground and slender ivory columns recede on the right. Many small crimson jellyfish drift between the distant arches. Pale sand winds along the lower edge while shafts of aqua sunlight cross the water from above. A spacious underwater landscape with overlapping reef terraces, tiny fish, flowing plants and transparent membranes; deep aquatic blue, magenta coral and pearl-white stone. An intricate surreal visionary painting with sculptural architecture, deep layered space, fine engraved detail, luminous color, dramatic shaded volumes, and a coherent wide cinematic composition.

scenes.name: cloud-palaces
scenes.prompt: Flying above an impossible mountain landscape of white marble palaces suspended among billowing violet and peach clouds. The foreground has a sweeping curved bridge entering from the lower left; tall gilded spires and floating islands recede toward a brilliant distant sunrise. Ribbons of luminous waterfalls spill from the islands into empty mist. Large open sky occupies the upper half, with tiny flocks of golden birds crossing between distant peaks. Vast aerial depth, luminous lavender atmosphere, rose gold structures and dramatic sunlight. An intricate surreal visionary painting with sculptural architecture, deep layered space, fine engraved detail, luminous color, dramatic shaded volumes, and a coherent wide cinematic composition.

scenes.name: cosmic-landscape
scenes.prompt: A vast cosmic landscape viewed from a crystalline mountain ledge. A giant amber ringed planet enters from the upper right, an emerald nebula sweeps diagonally through the dark sky, and bright star clusters recede into immense space. Jagged obsidian and amethyst mountains frame the lower foreground. Long branching rivers of molten gold run between the mountains toward distant luminous horizons. Small floating geometric crystals catch sharp colored highlights. Asymmetrical panoramic composition, black space, jewel-like green light and brilliant gold. An intricate surreal visionary painting with sculptural architecture, deep layered space, fine engraved detail, luminous color, dramatic shaded volumes, and a coherent wide cinematic composition.
